alex: Quick DR postmortem follow-up / action mini-tracker. Need owners + one-line confirms.

priya: I can own routing rules updates. Will add health-check gating and lower TTLs for critical records. ETA Fri COB.

marc: Ill own restore runbook edits. Adding: sha256 snapshot check, mount verification, 5-min smoke tests for auth+queue. PR by Mon.

tina: Ill schedule the tabletop + dry-run. Proposing Apr 20 09:00-11:00 PT. ops-bot please tentatively hold.

ops-bot: Hold added: DR tabletop 2026-04-13 09:00-10:00 PT; dry-run 2026-04-20 09:00-11:00 PT.

rachel: Ill take the S3 CRR + KMS audit. Quick scan found 2 buckets with replication off. Target Thu EOD for CSV+remediation steps.

alex: RACI short: routing=R=priya,A=alex,C=infra-net; restores=R=marc,A=alex,C=storage; CRR=R=rachel,A=alex,C=security; game-day=R=tina.

priya: config snippet Ill include: `failover: primary: eu-central-1 fallback: us-west-2 health_check: /_live threshold:3 interval_s:10 ttl_s:30`

marc: For smoke vs replay: synthetic probes by default + tiny replay (<=100 requests) for critical flows. Will add script.

tina: Tabletop agenda will include escalation contacts and rollback drill. Will circulate invite once infra confirms.

rachel: audit command sample: `aws s3api get-bucket-replication --bucket <name>`; patch script ready for apply.

alex: Please drop one-line status here by EOD so I can publish the consolidated tracker to execs. If any slip risk, call it out.

priya: Done  routing PR drafted, awaiting infra review.

marc: Done  runbook draft in Confluence, PR Monday.

tina: Done  holds in calendar, infra confirming.

rachel: Done  audit CSV in my drive, remediation steps drafted.

alex: Exec summary bullets for the deck: 1) routing fallbacks -> health gating + TTL tuning; 2) snapshot issues under disk pressure -> pre-merge checks + alerting; 3) replication drift -> audit + remediation scripts. Will publish tracker tomorrow AM. Update here if dates change. :eyes:
